prompt:
High-fidelity mobile UI design comp: one portrait phone screen filling the frame.

The app is Squirrel, a personal memory aid. This screen is its "chores" room, designed as a rail concourse split-flap departure board.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom:
1. A brushed steel header rail with tiny wide-tracked uppercase monospace: "SQUIRREL" at left, "CHORES" at right.
2. The body is a matte black board of four horizontal rows, each row a departure entry with three columns: a time column in warm cream monospace, a destination column in condensed uppercase white paint lettering on matte black flaps, and a small round lamp at the right edge.
   Row 1 (the next thing, highlighted with a thin orange border and a glowing orange lamp): time reads "NOW", destination reads "WATER THE PLANTS", small dim caption beneath reads "EVERY WEEK · A WHILE BACK".
   Row 2: "14:30" / "DENTIST" / caption "AGENDA · LEAVE 14:05".
   Row 3: "THU" / "BINS OUT" / caption "EVERY 2 WEEKS".
   Row 4: "—" / "THE BOILER NOISE" / caption "PILE · UNDECIDED".
3. Mid-flip detail: in row 1 the destination is caught mid-cascade — two or three character cells are blurred and half-rotated between letters, showing the flaps turning.
4. A footer strip of three wide action cells: the first bright orange (#e66d0d) with near-black uppercase monospace "DID IT", the others dark steel with cream monospace "HOW OFTEN" and "STOP".

MATERIALS: matte black flap faces with crisp white paint letters, brushed steel board frame, amber lamps, fine mechanical shadow between flaps.
STRICT PALETTE: #17130d #0c0a07 #241f19 #fffbf3 #fed6a7 #e66d0d #3b2560.
TYPE: one condensed uppercase sans on every flap in fixed character cells; tiny wide-tracked uppercase monospace for times, captions and actions.
MOOD: a public timetable at rush hour — authoritative, mechanical, unarguable. Not retro-cute, not skeuomorphic pastiche. The grid is strict.
